name: Lepas L8
shortDescription: The flagship Lepas smart SUV, with a 1.5TGDI engine, 7DCT transmission and a Super Hybrid option with up to 1,300 km combined range.
heroImageLabel: Lepas L8 smart SUV, exterior view
overview: The Lepas L8 is the flagship of the Lepas smart SUV range. Guided by Leopard Aesthetics, it pairs a confident, expressive design with a 3rd-generation 1.5TGDI engine, a two-tone cabin and a Sony premium sound system. Choose ICE, or the L8 Super Hybrid with up to 1,300 km combined range.

detailPage.heroHeadline: Lepas L8 smart SUV in the UAE
detailPage.heroSubcopy: Premium performance. Space for all. The flagship Lepas, available as ICE or Super Hybrid with up to 1,300 km combined range.
detailPage.exteriorImageLabel: Lepas L8 safety features, cutaway view

designGallery.heading: Auto Locking System
designGallery.body: Doors lock automatically once you drive away, so your cabin stays secure without a second thought.

designGallery.heading: Front Side Airbags
designGallery.body: Part of a six-airbag system that protects front occupants in the event of a side impact.

designGallery.imageLabel: Lepas L8 eCall emergency call system
designGallery.heading: eCall Emergency Call System
designGallery.body: Connects you to emergency services when you need help, wherever the road takes you.

highlights.title: RCTA (Rear Cross Traffic Alert)
highlights.body: Warns you of vehicles approaching from the side as you reverse out of a parking space.

highlights.title: 540° HD Panoramic View Camera
highlights.body: A high-definition view around and beneath the vehicle for confident manoeuvring in tight spaces.

highlights.title: ISOFIX Child Seat Anchors
highlights.body: Standardised anchor points make fitting a child seat quick and secure.

highlights.title: 6 Airbags
highlights.body: Six airbags surround the cabin to protect driver and passengers.

terrainItems.title: LED Dipped Headlights
terrainItems.body: Headlights inspired by the eyes of the leopard give the L8 an unmistakable look, day and night.

terrainItems.title: Unibody Frame
terrainItems.body: A rigid unibody frame delivers a composed ride and a strong safety structure.

terrainItems.title: Roof Rack
terrainItems.body: An integrated roof rack adds practical carrying capacity for weekend adventures.

terrainItems.title: GSO Side Mirrors
terrainItems.body: GSO-compliant side mirrors offer a clear view of the road around you.

exteriorItems.title: 1.5TGDI Engine (3rd Generation)
exteriorItems.body: Delivers advanced turbocharged performance with stronger output and smoother response.

exteriorItems.title: 7DCT Transmission (4th Generation)
exteriorItems.body: Pre-selects the next gear to deliver near-instant shifts with minimal interruption.

exteriorItems.title: Regenerative Braking (PHEV)
exteriorItems.body: On the Super Hybrid, adjustable energy recovery converts braking energy into electrical power to help recharge the battery.

name: Lepas L4
shortDescription: A compact smart SUV for the city, with a 1.5TCI engine, 6DCT transmission, electric sunroof and ventilated driver seat.
